title: Exec Snapshot Playbook: rolling 15-minute roadmap micro-presentations for product ops
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, repeatable playbook and artifact templates that allow product managers and eng leads to run 15-minute rolling roadmap micro-presentations for monthly exec syncs, ad-hoc stakeholder checkpoints, and Board prep.

Background: Current readouts are heavy (30–60m decks) and infrequent. Execs and platform stakeholders repeatedly ask for concise signals: is an initiative green/amber/red, what are the top evidence points, and what are the concrete asks. The micro-presentation format reduces prep friction, increases cadence, and creates a standard signal vocabulary for cross-functional prioritization.

Scope:
- Deliver a 1-page template (one slide) + 3-minute speaker notes for each active initiative.
- Define mandatory signal cards (status badge, ETA variance, SLO delta, cost delta, blockers, primary mitigation).
- Produce facilitator checklist for Product Ops to run a 60-minute rolling session with up to 6 initiatives (6x10m slots).
- Create a signal mapping to portfolio asks (budget, capacity, escalation, de-prioritization).
- Pilot with Runtime and Console PMs for March monthly exec sync and iterate.

Out of scope: full QBR decks, long-form narratives, confidential legal briefings.

Deliverables: 1) One-page initiative template (PNG + editable Google Slide). 2) Speaker notes + two-minute demo script. 3) Facilitator runbook (timing, queue rules, parking-lot play). 4) Automation spec for extracting current metrics into the template (dashboard widget definition).
acceptance_criteria: One-page template available in Drive and approved by two exec sponsors
Facilitator runbook published and validated in a dry run with Product Ops
Automation spec created and prioritized with Eng (clear AC and owner)
Pilot run completed with at least 4 initiatives and feedback captured
decisions: Adopt 15-minute micro-presentation cadence for monthly exec check-ins (decision by Head of Product)
Signal vocabulary limited to: Status Badge, ETA Delta, SLO Delta, Cost Delta, Top Blocker, Primary Ask
